positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Geospatial big data startup backed by Sequoia Capital & Google Venture.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Led development a web application for collateral management in ASP.Net Web Form and deployed the web application on production
- Developed RESTfule API endpoints for a web service managing client, account, issuer, security, and portfolio data in ASP.Net Web API with Entity Framework. The API endpoints pulled financial data from SQL Server by Entity Framework and applied business rules. Additionally implemented global logging and error handling for the API endpoints.
- Implemented the Back-end for checking validation of data in PostgreSQL and system requirements in Python script with SQLAlchemy.
- Implemented and maintained perl script schedule jobs in auto-system. Most schedule jobs pulled financial data from SQL Server or Oracle Database, and analyzed it then created reports or sent email.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Design and built a web application for collateral management in ASP.Net Web Form. The web application was designed in layer architecture and implemented in C#.
- Participated in design of the web service managing client, account, issuer, security, and portfolio data. The web service was designed by following MVC and N-tier architecture.
- Implemented and maintained perl script schedule jobs in auto-system. Most schedule jobs pulled financial data from SQL Server or Oracle Database and analyzed it then created reports or sent email.

projects.title: Classifying Driver's Behavior
projects.description:
- Participating research team advised by Dr. Santiago Ontanon for Master thesis paper research
- Researching methods to classify automobile driver's behavior for Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP). CHOP uses results for diagnosis of teenager ADHD.
- Implementing a deep neural network on Tensorflow. A deep neural network consists of  multi-layer Auto-encoder to reduce dimensions in  driver's simulation data and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network for time domain in simulation data.
- Experimenting the deep neural network with different parameters for performances comparison.

projects.title: Deep Neural Network Stock Data Analyzer
projects.description:
- Implemented LSTM deep neural network to classify preferred stocks.
- Trained the deep neural network with two groups of given data.
- Deploying the deep neural network with container accessible by RESTful API endpoints.
